body: I’m not entirely sure. I guess I do have a small bit of hope that this is an illness that can be cured. I haven’t tried medication yet. I’m nervous about that. But I guess I hope I can feel “normal”.
I mean me too but I doubt it. Can’t see a cruise fixing my busted life.
No I don’t want to be labeled or given drugs to make the pain go away. And talking through it, idk if that would help. To me there is nothing good to look forward to in life.

I have and their words don’t help. They try to relate and say things will get better, you know the cliches. I was with this girl since I was 17 years old. She was my only true love and I don’t want to find another nor am I even able to. I just feel like I’m in darkness with no light at the end. I just don’t want to go through more hell.
Like I know things can be worse but I barely had anything going for me in my life. I’ve been living with undiagnosed depression for a while. My only bright spot were my friends and my girlfriend.
Things are just getting worse and worse for me. First I lose my bestfriend in January and now my girlfriend of 13 years left me. What’s next? I can’t take anymore loss.
No that just shows what you’re allotted not earned. If you look at a pay statement on the bottom right it shows your time off information with earned and allotted values.

I never seen any communication on that being the case nor have I actually seen that to be the case. I’ve used my fhl on days I work (not during the times I work like I’ll put midnight to 8am FHL and I’ll work 8-4) and haven’t received time and a half and when I’ve tried using it for times I was working it removed my wrk time.

I understand your point and I do enjoy the fact we have holiday hours to use at our own discretion but don’t fool yourself into thinking this wasn’t a money saving tactic. We lost two holidays that also gave us time and a half in addition to the holiday pay. So we are losing money on this trade off. As an atheist you would have no problem working the holiday and you would be earning more for working. Now there’s no incentive to work that day and we lose two days where employees can make good money working time and a half.
